entries.what: Caught the 6:48 Tule Line from Flats Junction with a large masala chai from Anh's cart, then sat through MWF classes at Bayshore State.
entries.outcome: Made it to the 9 a.m. class on time.

entries.what: Worked his front desk shift at the career center and added two applications to the spreadsheet between students.
Back at Marisol Gardens, ate rajma and rice from his Sunday meal prep, then tweaked resume v19 until nearly 2 a.m. while Marcus was at Ridgeline.
Voted at the Vinca Avenue Community Center on Election Day, his first local election, yes on Measure K, before heading to the Tuesday ops management class.
entries.outcome: Vote cast; sticker on his jacket.

entries.what: Tuesday 3 p.m. mock interview with Lena, answering 'tell me about yourself' standing up.
entries.outcome: Lena gave notes on pacing; he booked next week's slot.

entries.what: Evening on case comp slides with the team, then home to split takeout leftovers with Marcus before his shift.
Got the email that Harrowgate Distribution wants a second-round video interview on Nov 18, the referral Sunita arranged having worked.
entries.outcome: Interview on the calendar for Nov 18.

entries.what: Called Sunita on his break to thank her, then told his mom Manpreet the news by text.
entries.outcome: Both excited; Manpreet wants a Sunday update.

entries.what: Morning classes, then paid his chai tab at Anh's cart on the way home and pasted the Harrowgate job description into a doc.
Rode the 6:48 and attended Dr. Ashby's Thursday ops class, then caught Ashby's office hours with a quick check-in on the letter.
entries.outcome: Ashby said the letter is in progress.

entries.what: Late-night planning for case comp week: asked for a realistic schedule and ended up with one that has him sleeping five hours a night.
entries.outcome: Schedule saved despite Marcus's quiet-hours note on the door.

entries.what: Thursday night laundry at the card-only Marisol Gardens laundry room while editing slides on his phone.
Skipped Friday classes' extra stuff, did MWF-style morning lecture and a career center desk shift, fielding questions from sophomores about internships.
Case team meeting at Bayshore to rehearse the presentation for tomorrow's competition.
Early dinner, then wrote a Harrowgate research outline until past midnight.
Regional supply-chain case competition at Bayshore with his team of four, presenting in the afternoon round.
entries.outcome: Team finished the presentation and waited for results.

entries.what: Went to dinner with teammates after the competition, then got home and slept in while Marcus worked nights.
Meal-prepped four containers of rajma and rice, then took the train-free trip to his parents' Pell Road house for Sunday dinner.
entries.outcome: Came home with a tub of dal.

entries.what: Manpreet's Sunday call-style check-in at the table about Harrowgate, and Gurpreet at langar asking again about a CDL.
Evening prep for the week, updating the spreadsheet and reading about Harrowgate.
